name: Aariz cephalometric benchmark (Khalid, Fraz 2023) and the ISBI 2015 cephalograms
what: 1,000 lateral cephalograms from 7 devices with 29 landmarks and a cervical vertebral maturation (CVM) stage per film, C2 to C4 in every image (arXiv:2302.07797; the CEPHA29 challenge at ISBI 2023); the ISBI 2015 set of 400 cephalograms with 19 landmarks and no CVM stage is openly downloadable
level_truth: C2 to C4 by the CVM stage (named vertebra shapes); no other level
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the 400-film ISBI 2015 set is open, the 1,000-film set by request to the authors (to confirm on the page); pediatric anchors for the top of the cervical counter from seven devices
how_to_get: Read the data link in the paper at https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.07797 and the ISBI 2015 challenge page for the 400-film set.

Fetch the open 400-film set as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the address the page gives.
For the 1,000-film set the owner writes to the authors; any agreement is the owner's to sign.
